protocol.runtime: Native Cloudflare Workflows, D1 and R2; actual makeCoreHttp and browserHttpClientLayer
protocol.scope: Isolated synthetic Users, consumed pairings, valid bound sessions and production migrations; GET /categories only; no financial data or provider credentials
protocol.transport: Injected Fetch invokes the actual Core handler inside the native Workflow; excludes browser internet RTT and cross-Worker HTTP routing
protocol.order: ABBA, repeated three times; A=unlimited baseline, B=two active transfers; eight concurrent logical reads per burst; new synthetic User per burst
protocol.gates: Count all attempts and outcomes, including declared resource refusals; no warmup samples removed
protocol.limitations: Six paired bursts; native platform proof, not authenticated production browser traffic; does not prove standalone category latency, CPU, heap, actual invoice cost or queue enqueue-to-completion p95 gains

priorRunCaveat: Earlier complete run retained two baseline unavailable responses and zero candidate errors, derived from body.error.code and category cardinality. Its field named status was returned as unknown by the Workflow instance API. Primary run uses httpCode and validates all 96 responses as 200. Earlier setup attempts failed on a transient status API 500, a miswired injected Fetch (401), and a baseline unavailable response before full outcome capture; none is included in the primary comparison.

reproduction.instructions: Replace ${REPOSITORY} with the checkout path. Save coreAdapter to /tmp/fidy-core-read-profile-worker.ts; save buildHarness, cloudflareApiHelper and runHarness to their referenced /tmp filenames. Use the repository-pinned Bun. Run buildHarness, then runHarness with existing Wrangler OAuth. Harness creates private task-owned D1/R2/Workflow/Worker resources and deletes them in finally. Independently GET each resource path to verify 404. Do not use production financial/provider bindings.
